basis: A shared glossary centralizes definitions but does not ensure that usage elsewhere cannot drift. Expressing consistency as the purpose preserves the source relationship without the absolute assurance.
replacement:
A cell in the matrices below is one glyph, and two different claims can wear
the same one. [The glossary](../glossary/) defines each word, from
`docs/site/src/glossary.ts` rather than from this page, to help keep meanings
consistent across pages.
